_doc: GX5 static decals (src/static_decals.cpp, docs/graphics-overhaul.md#gx5-decals). Scattered per building from its rooms, hearths and windows, deterministic from the instance id, evaluated in the wall material (lit, with relief). Rates are expected counts: per wall per 6 m (stains) or 5 m (scuffs, pocks), per room, per window or per sill; all but soot, outlines and pocks scale with the building's wear (Finish > Wear, 0..2). density multiplies everything; Settings > Material detail Low switches the pass off.
